items.description:
RA Motors and Panelbeaters is a motor mechanical and panelbeating business in Ladanna, Polokwane, established in 2004. It describes itself as a specialist in motor mechanical work and panelbeating, with more than 20 years of experience across Limpopo.

Its services range from minor A services through to major B and C services, and it carries out repairs and overhauls on engines, gearboxes, differentials, brakes, hydraulics, CV joints and wheel bearings. Electrical diagnostics, fault finding and wiring work are offered for all vehicles, along with panelbeating, spray painting and towing. The business says it works with nine or more insurers and is an RMI accredited and SAMBRA member.

The workshop is listed in Ladanna, Polokwane, and the business says it covers everything from routine services to full overhauls.

items.description:
STAFIX Electric Fence & Security is the Southern African distributor of STAFIX and JVA electric fence energisers, supplying imported and locally manufactured fencing and perimeter-security equipment to the agricultural, wildlife and security markets. Alongside its product range, the business runs electric-fence training courses covering agricultural, wall-top, free-standing and game-fencing applications, with Polokwane listed among its official training locations on its own contact page.

Its products and training are backed by a network of accredited installers, giving farmers, game-reserve operators, security companies and other fencing-industry customers a technical grounding as well as the equipment itself. The training side sets it apart from a straightforward equipment supplier, since installers can learn the correct application for each fence type before fitting it.

STAFIX Electric Fence & Security trades from Nirvana in Polokwane, serving customers across the agricultural, wildlife and perimeter-security sectors who need both the energisers and fencing hardware and the know-how to install them correctly.

Stay on Plein is a guesthouse in Polokwane with six luxurious units that can accommodate 16 guests. Each unit has its own theme and character, from a Moroccan-inspired room with a patio overlooking the garden and swimming pool to a colourful South African kitsch room with two single beds.

The guesthouse is in a secure complex with beautiful gardens, and the website describes it as safe and secure. Some units have handmade decor and patios, and others are described as fresh, natural and tranquil for a good night's rest. The business also offers functions alongside its accommodation, and guests can browse the units and gallery on the website before booking.

Steendal Guest House is a garden guesthouse on Bendor Drive in Sterpark, offering individually decorated en-suite rooms, including family rooms with private bathrooms. Each room comes with tea and coffee facilities, a refrigerator, a work desk, a TV and free toiletries, and the property offers free Wi-Fi and private parking for guests.

Guests can start the day with a full English or Irish breakfast, and the grounds include a swimming pool and a braai area for relaxing between activities. The guesthouse is pet-friendly, which makes it a practical choice for travellers who don't want to leave animals behind.

Steendal Guest House is in Sterpark, Polokwane, about 8km from Polokwane International Airport, putting it within easy reach for business travellers passing through and families visiting the city alike.

The Guesthouse 8 on Impala is a guesthouse in Polokwane, about 11 km from the Polokwane Game Reserve, with an outdoor swimming pool, a hot tub, a bar and free private parking. Every unit has air conditioning and a desk, and the Standard Queen Room offers a comfortable base for a stay.

Breakfast is served daily with buffet, a la carte and continental options, and the property offers free WiFi throughout. Reception can give tips on the area, and the guesthouse is about 3.9 km from Peter Mokaba Stadium, 7 km from the Pietersburg Snake and Reptile Park and 13 km from the Bakone Malapa open-air museum. Polokwane International Airport is about 6 km away.

Cashbuild Polokwane Central is a branch of the national Cashbuild hardware and building-materials chain, stocking a broad range of building materials, cement, timber, hardware, plumbing supplies and tools for construction and renovation projects. The branch also offers in-store and online quotations, giving customers pricing on a job before they commit to buying the materials.

Free local delivery is available on qualifying purchases, which suits contractors moving bulk materials as well as homeowners who would rather not transport heavy loads themselves, and the store also has free customer parking on site.

The branch trades from the corner of Boom and Excelsior Street in Polokwane Central, serving contractors, DIY customers and homeowners working on anything from small repairs to full building projects.

items.description:
Country Blue Luxury Accommodation offers affordable luxury accommodation for short and longer stays in Polokwane, with rooms for solo travellers, couples and families. The business describes it as a haven of peace, with a serene setting, modern comfort and a timeless style.

Each room is designed for calm and restful sleep, and guests can enjoy tranquil gardens, a lounge and elegant shared spaces. The business says it suits both leisure and business travellers, and its team focuses on details that enhance each stay. Bookings can be made on the website, through NightsBridge or through the Lekker Slaap and Booking listings.

The property is close to Mediclinic Limpopo, with its hospital about 840 m away, the Mediclinic day clinic and Intercare Polokwane about 1 km away, and the provincial hospital about 2.5 km away.

items.description:
Incredible Connection is part of South Africa's long-running technology retail network, selling laptops, desktop computers, printers, cellphones, tablets and gaming consoles alongside accessories and software. This store trades from the Mall of the North in Bendor, confirmed on the centre's own current store directory, where it sits among the mall's electronics and technology retailers.

Many branches in the group also run an in-store Technical Centre for installations, upgrades and repairs, giving customers somewhere to turn once a purchase needs setting up or fixing. The Polokwane store keeps the same weekday and weekend trading pattern as the rest of the mall, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays.

It serves home users, students and businesses around Bendor and greater Polokwane who are shopping for computers, mobile devices and other everyday technology.

Kingsley Heath is a South African luxury fashion house, established in 1994 and known for menswear and womenswear, leather goods and footwear inspired by the textures and tones of the African landscape. Its Polokwane boutique at Mall of the North is listed on the brand's own official store locator, confirming it as a current Kingsley Heath outlet rather than just a mall directory entry.

The store carries the brand's seasonal fashion collections together with its leather accessories, giving shoppers in Limpopo access to a label that otherwise trades mainly from boutiques in South Africa's larger cities, as well as in Namibia and London.

It serves customers looking for premium, lifestyle-driven fashion rather than mass-market clothing, trading from the Mall of the North in Bendor alongside the centre's other fashion retailers.

items.description:
Meropa Casino & Entertainment World is a casino and entertainment complex in Ivy Park, offering gaming tables and slot machines alongside the Jembe Tavern for live music, comedy and cabaret nights, and family attractions including mini-golf and go-karting. Within the same complex, the House of Asante Spa gives visitors a hospitality option beyond the gaming floor, offering massages, aromatherapy, hot-stone therapy, manicures, pedicures, waxing, body exfoliation and facials.

The spa is open daily from 08:00 to 22:00 on both weekdays and weekends, and it welcomes groups, couples and bridal parties as well as individual guests, tailoring treatments to each visitor's wellness needs rather than offering one fixed menu.

Between the casino floor, the tavern, the family attractions and the spa, Meropa in Ivy Park serves a wide range of visitors, from gaming and nightlife customers to conference and hotel guests and anyone booking a spa treatment on its own.

items.description:
Plein On Suid Guesthouse is a recently renovated guesthouse in Hospital Park, with rooms that each have a private bathroom, a refrigerator, a TV, a kitchenette and a private entrance. Guests staying here have access to an outdoor swimming pool, a garden and braai areas, free Wi-Fi, room service and daily housekeeping, so self-catering guests and those who'd rather be looked after both have options.

Current booking reviews give the property a location score of around 9 out of 10, reflecting how central it is within walking distance of Peter Mokaba Stadium and the surrounding Polokwane CBD.

The guesthouse is on Plein Street in Hospital Park, and suits couples, families and other travellers who want private, self-contained rooms with hotel-style extras such as room service, rather than a shared guesthouse setup.

Theo Goosen Estate Agents & Auctioneers has served the Limpopo property market from Polokwane since 1960, handling residential, commercial, industrial and farm property sales alongside property auctions. The firm's own website currently carries active listings not only around Polokwane but also in Modimolle, Tzaneen, Vivo, Marble Hall and other parts of the province, reflecting a reach well beyond the city itself.

2025 marked 65 years in business for the agency, a milestone that puts it among the longer-established estate agencies operating in Limpopo, and the firm relocated to its current General Maritz Street office in Bendor earlier that year.

It serves property sellers, buyers, landlords, tenants and investors across Limpopo, offering both conventional estate-agency sales and auction-based disposals of residential, commercial and farm property from its Bendor base in Polokwane.

Within the Mall of the North's retail mix, Totalsports is the mall's dedicated sporting-goods store, and its listing on the centre's own official store directory specifically credits the branch with supplying performance wear, running shoes and sports accessories to shoppers in Bendor. That focus on performance gear, rather than general sportswear, is what the mall itself highlights about the store.

As part of the wider Totalsports chain, founded in 1982 and now operating under The Foschini Group as the largest sports retailer in Southern Africa, the Polokwane branch carries footwear and apparel from international sports brands alongside running- and training-specific ranges.

Runners, gym-goers and other fitness-focused shoppers are the obvious customers here, but the store also serves anyone shopping for everyday sports casual wear, trading from the Mall of the North in Bendor.

Bona Manzi is a borehole drilling and water systems business in Polokwane, founded in 1985. It specialises in drilling boreholes and installing water pumps, tanks and stands for industrial, commercial and domestic customers.

Its services include drilling for home and industrial water use, pressure pumps, generators, the installation of steel and PVC casings, tank stands and tanks, and manhole covers. The business says it works in Polokwane and the surrounding areas, including Louis Trichardt, Giyani, Seshego, Tzaneen, Mokopane and Thohoyandou.

Its website explains the company's work and invites enquiries from customers who want a borehole or a complete water system installed.

CV World is a drive shaft specialist in Futura, Polokwane, operating since 1991. It supplies, manufactures and fits drive shaft components for all makes, including CV joints, gearboxes, propshafts, differentials, clutches and brakes.

The business focuses on the difficult parts, such as discontinued or unusual CV joints and shafts, and it helps customers identify parts when catalogues fail. It also modifies and fabricates parts where needed and offers advice on whether to repair or replace. Its work includes fleet and commercial servicing, and it offers a one-year guarantee on CV fitment.

Customers can send photos, measurements or an old sample on WhatsApp, and the business supplies customers across South Africa from its base in Polokwane.

Gemstone Bed and Breakfast is a guesthouse and day spa in Mankweng Zone 1, with individually named en-suite rooms, including the Diamond, Ruby, Pearl and Emerald rooms, each with a double bed, DStv and tea and coffee facilities. The property's own website confirms the room names and the on-site day spa, and independent hotel-booking data lists the business as 'Gemstone Bed and Breakfast Day Spa', carrying close to 100 guest reviews.

Guests can combine an overnight stay with spa treatments on site, rather than travelling elsewhere for pampering, which makes it a practical stop for people visiting the University of Limpopo's Turfloop campus or elsewhere in Mankweng for business or family reasons.

The guesthouse is at Stand 516 in Mankweng Zone 1 and is open daily from 08:00 to 19:00, serving overnight guests and day-spa customers from the surrounding area.

Shoppers looking for women's fashion at the Mall of the North will find Miladys stocked with clothing, footwear and accessories sized to fit a wide range of body types, from everyday basics through to smarter occasion wear. The Bendor branch appears on the mall's own current store directory, confirming it as one of the centre's active women's fashion retailers rather than simply a listed address.

Miladys has been part of South African retail since 1947 and now trades under the Mr Price Group, giving the Polokwane branch the buying power and seasonal ranges of a national chain while still serving shoppers locally. The store keeps mall hours, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 on weekends and public holidays.

It's a straightforward stop for women shopping for clothing, shoes and accessories at the Mall of the North in Bendor, without needing to visit a dedicated boutique elsewhere in the city.

items.description:
Car Service City in Superbia is a vehicle servicing and repair workshop handling all makes and models, with a particular focus on vehicles that have come out of their manufacturer's motor plan, generally cars three years and older. The workshop carries out servicing, repairs and replacement work using genuine parts, and includes a free 62-point vehicle check with every major service, giving customers a broader health check on their vehicle beyond the specific job booked in.

The branch's own information confirms the Polokwane workshop has been operating since 2015, giving it roughly a decade of trading history in Superbia rather than being a recent addition to the area.

It serves vehicle owners across all makes, including bakkies and 4x4s, who need routine maintenance or mechanical repairs once their vehicle is no longer covered by a dealer motor plan, from its base in Superbia, Polokwane.

Debbie Mouton Jewellers is an independent Polokwane jewellery retailer, part of the Gold City Jewellers group, selling platinum, diamond, gold, palladium, silver and gemstone jewellery alongside custom-made and hand-picked pieces. The business is an accredited member of the Jewellery Council of South Africa and an official retailer of TAG Heuer and Tissot watches, both confirmed through its own current website.

Beyond new jewellery and watch sales, the store also handles jewellery valuations and repairs, giving customers a place to maintain or get pieces assessed rather than only buy new ones. Its own site states two Debbie Mouton Jewellers stores opened at Mall of the North in 2011, putting well over a decade of trading behind the current branch.

It serves jewellery and luxury-watch customers from its Mall of the North store in Bendor, Polokwane, covering everything from an engagement ring to a watch service.

Jabez Christian Academy is a combined Christian school in Eduan Park, teaching from Grade RR through to Grade 12 under the National Core Curriculum, with Matric candidates examined through the IEB. Daily Christian instruction runs alongside the academic programme, and classes are kept to a maximum of 25 learners, giving teachers a smaller group to work with at each grade.

Outside the classroom, learners can take part in sport including netball, soccer, volleyball and athletics, and a wide range of cultural and extra-curricular activities such as drama, chess, choir, cooking, music, ballroom dancing, art and computer classes. That spread of activities runs across the school's pre-school, primary and high school phases.

Jabez Christian Academy serves families in Eduan Park and the wider Polokwane area looking for a Christian education that pairs academic preparation for Matric with a broad range of sport and cultural options.

Legit sells women's fashion clothing and accessories aimed at the middle-to-lower income market, part of the Retailability group's network of more than 460 stores across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and eSwatini. Its Bendor branch is listed on the Mall of the North's own current store directory, confirming it as one of the mall's active fashion tenants.

The Polokwane store follows the centre's general trading pattern, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 18:00 on weekends and public holidays, giving shoppers a wide window to browse its seasonal ranges.

It serves women shopping for affordable, everyday fashion and accessories, trading from the Mall of the North in Bendor alongside the mall's other clothing retailers.

Levi's at the Mall of the North sells the brand's denim and casual clothing ranges, with the store confirmed on the mall's own current directory as one of its fashion tenants in Bendor. The global Levi's brand dates back to 1873 and re-entered the South African market in 1994, with some ranges still manufactured locally at the company's Epping facility.

The Polokwane store carries jeans and associated casual wear for men and women, and keeps the same hours as much of the rest of the mall: 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays.

It serves shoppers across Bendor and greater Polokwane who are after denim and casual apparel from an established global brand, rather than a store-brand alternative.

items.description:
Virgin Active Polokwane is a full-service health club at the Pietersburg Sports Node in Polokwane Central, with cardio and strength-training areas, a swimming pool, a steam room and a supervised kids' facility for children from six weeks to seven years old. The club's own page confirms it offers personal training covering weight loss, muscle gain, functional fitness and sport-specific training, alongside swim coaching run from the same site.

That combination means members working toward a specific goal, whether that's losing weight, building strength or improving a particular sport, can get one-on-one guidance rather than training alone, and swimmers of various levels have coaching available without needing to go elsewhere.

The club serves gym members and anyone in Polokwane Central looking for structured support around fitness, strength, weight management, swimming or personal training, alongside standard gym access.

Cambridge Food Seshego Circle is a supermarket built around fresh food, stocking fresh meat, fruit and vegetables, hot bread from its in-store bakery and fresh takeaways alongside its general grocery range. Service departments sit alongside the fresh offering, giving shoppers a single stop for both everyday groceries and freshly prepared items.

The store forms part of the Massmart group's Cambridge Food chain, which built its reputation on fresh produce and meat rather than a purely dry-goods grocery model, and this branch keeps that same focus at Seshego Circle Shopping Centre.

It serves local households and shoppers in Seshego looking for groceries and fresh food at affordable prices, and is open Monday to Saturday from 07:00 to 20:00 and Sundays from 07:00 to 19:00.

Scrap Metal Lady buys and collects scrap metal in bulk, working with a minimum collection of around 12,000kg at a time and using its own trucks to carry out the collection, at no transport cost to the seller. That minimum volume and in-house transport set it apart from smaller operators who rely on customers delivering material themselves.

A current business directory listing for the company also places offices in both Gauteng and Limpopo, pointing to a sourcing operation that reaches beyond Polokwane alone, even though this listing covers its Hospital Park base.

Its customers include demolition companies, mines, scrap yards, schools, farms and automobile yards, as well as households with scrap to clear, and the no-charge collection model is aimed squarely at sellers who have a large volume of metal but no way to transport it themselves.

The Macaw Nest is an accommodation and events venue in Dalmada, operating under the name 'The Macaw Nest Accommodation & Events' according to its current location listing. That naming reflects a business built around two things, overnight stays and hosting functions, rather than a single-purpose guesthouse or hall.

Its listed opening times vary through the week, with later hours on Friday and Saturday than on other days, which fits a venue that hosts evening functions as well as guests staying overnight.

The Macaw Nest serves overnight accommodation guests as well as customers looking to book the property as an events venue, trading from Dalmada on the outskirts of Polokwane.

61 On Ireland is a 4-star guest house in Polokwane's Moregloed area, set in a rock village with koi ponds, indigenous plants and contemporary architecture. The business describes it as a place to relax and recharge, whether guests are in town for business or leisure.

The guest house has air-conditioned rooms, including the Mother of Pearl deluxe queen suite, the Sunflower deluxe twin suite, the Fireplace deluxe king suite and the Rock House standard queen and twin rooms. Breakfast is served each morning, and the property is pet friendly. It also offers an events venue and conference facilities for functions and business events.

Its central location puts guests close to business hubs, shopping and a selection of restaurants in the city.

items.description:
Taxila Secondary School is a public high school in Nirvana, Polokwane, which has been educating learners since 1927. It offers education from Grade 8 to Grade 12, including Grade 8 and 9 education and Grade 10 to 12 streams, along with academic support programmes and sports activities.

The school describes itself as a tradition of educational excellence, promoting academic achievement, discipline and integrity. Its vision is to produce well-rounded, capable and responsible citizens ready for higher education, the workplace and society. The school's mission is to provide teaching and learning that gives every learner meaningful and lasting outcomes.

The school is at 347 Orient Drive, Nirvana, and its website includes an admissions page, a notice board, a gallery and staff and learner information.

The Lofts is an overnight accommodation in Polokwane, designed around the surrounding landscape to offer a unique, comfortable and fun stay. Its rooms are described as spacious, and the business says its fares are competitive and its service is attentive.

Rooms have free WiFi, air conditioning and a television with 45 DStv channels, and housekeeping is included. Guests can choose self-catering or a restaurant that serves breakfasts, meals and drinks at the bar. Laundry is available on request, linen and towels are replaced, and there is an outdoor space for fresh air and braais.

The Lofts also has conference facilities for business events and private functions, and the team says it will do its best to make a stay easy and satisfying for travellers.

Unjani Clinic Lebowakgomo is a nurse-led primary healthcare clinic opposite Mall@Lebo, offering diagnosis and treatment of common ailments, including medication, alongside a well-baby clinic with immunisations. Current local information on the clinic also lists TB testing, pregnancy and antenatal care, sonar services, vaccinations, vision screening and general health checks among its services.

It forms part of the wider Unjani Clinic network, a model of clinics across South Africa that are owned and run by professional nurses rather than operating as franchised GP practices, which keeps routine primary care accessible without always needing a doctor's appointment.

The clinic serves the Lebowakgomo community and patients needing primary healthcare close to home, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00.

Mayfair Gearbox Polokwane specialises in gearbox repair and replacement for light motor cars, LDVs and trucks. It repairs and reconditions manual gearboxes, and it strips and quotes each gearbox free of charge.

The business also supplies and fits clutches for manual transmissions, refurbishes flywheels, and repairs and reconditions differentials for trucks, cars, bakkies and SUVs. It services manual passenger vehicles, 4x4s, heavy commercial vehicles, buses, trucks and earth-moving equipment, and says it aims to get each job right the first time.

The team aims to offer top-class service at affordable prices, with transmission and differential services that help customers minimise downtime. The business is in Annadale, Polokwane.

Seeff Polokwane is a residential estate agency that has operated in the city for more than 18 years, with separate sales and rental teams handling houses, apartments, cluster developments, security estates, vacant land and guesthouses. The agency's own area profile confirms it currently markets listings across Bendor, Ivy Park, Flora Park, Polokwane Central and the surrounding suburbs, including houses, townhouses, sectional-title units and vacant land.

The agency is also noted for marketing new residential developments in Polokwane, putting it alongside the individual resale listings that make up most of an estate agency's day-to-day business.

It serves property buyers, sellers, landlords, tenants and investors from its Platinum Park office in Bendor Park, covering residential property across several of Polokwane's established suburbs rather than one single area.

Sonpra Lebowakgomo stocks upholstery and craft-leather supplies, including fabrics, foam, thread and tools alongside vinyls, genuine leather and canvas for motor-vehicle interiors, home decor and outdoor upholstery projects. The company's own website states its owners bring more than 28 years of experience in the upholstery-supply trade, built up before this particular branch opened.

The Lebowakgomo store was one of two new Sonpra branches opened alongside a Polokwane warehouse outlet, extending the supplier's reach beyond its original base into Lepelle Crossing Shopping Centre in Zone BA.

It serves upholsterers, furniture restorers, interior designers, craft users and vehicle-interior customers, as well as DIY customers taking on their own reupholstering projects, giving them a single supplier for the fabrics, tools and materials the job needs.

Victoria Place Guest House is a Victorian-style guesthouse in Polokwane, set in Victorian gardens and operating since 1997. The owners describe it as a place of peace and relaxation with extreme comfort and warm hospitality, and the property is a member of the Polokwane Accommodation Association.

The guesthouse offers guest house rooms, a presidential suite and self-catering accommodation. It has been a finalist in the AA Accommodation Awards five times since 1999, and it holds the AA Quality Assured Superior rating. The website also lists a 2009 Limpopo diamond award for executive guest houses, a Travellers' Choice Award and an American Express accommodation award.

Bookings can be made on the website, and the guesthouse is set in the Hospital Park area of Polokwane.

Christ Church Cathedral is the Anglican church of Polokwane, part of the Diocese of St Mark the Evangelist within the Anglican Church of Southern Africa. It is the only Anglican church in Polokwane, which was known as Pietersburg, and it has a history going back more than a century.

The cathedral holds Eucharist services on Sundays at 07:30 and on Wednesdays at 10:00. Its website lists a Sunday school, a youth group, the Mothers' Union and other church groups, along with sermons, a year planner and a history of its clergy.

The cathedral is at 82 Biccard Street in Polokwane Central, and visitors can find the contact details and frequently asked questions on its site.

Destiny Inn Lodge offers lodge accommodation in rooms and self-catering cottages, each with a private bathroom, set among gardens with an outdoor swimming pool and an informal restaurant on site. Current hotel-booking information confirms the property as a 3-star graded hotel carrying more than 250 guest reviews, along with free Wi-Fi, free parking, air conditioning in some rooms and an airport shuttle service.

That shuttle option, together with the restaurant and pool, makes it a workable base for guests without their own transport as well as for those simply looking to relax on the property rather than go out for meals.

The lodge serves leisure and business travellers looking for accommodation in the Dalmada area of Polokwane, from its Plot 136 base.

items.description:
The Place Food Eatery is a small restaurant and takeaway in Lebowakgomo, serving an a la carte menu of seafood, meat, poultry and vegetarian dishes alongside daily specials, hot and cold platters and desserts. Its menu and current details are shared through its own Facebook page rather than a standalone website, which is also where its trading hours are confirmed.

The eatery was established with support from a small-business empowerment programme aimed at women entrepreneurs, giving it a backing beyond a purely private start-up. It generally trades Wednesday to Saturday, open from around mid-morning to early evening.

It serves local customers looking for prepared meals and takeaway fast food in Lebowakgomo, offering a sit-down a la carte option alongside quicker takeaway orders.
